headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, securing a 17-1 victory. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies), Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies), Matt Gage (San Francisco Giants), Ha-Seong Kim (Atlanta Braves), Jakob Junis (Texas Rangers), Evan Sisk (Pittsburgh Pirates), Freddy Fermin (San Diego Padres), and Randy Vásquez (San Diego Padres), who have all been placed on the injured list.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for SS Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 7-1 victory. Bryan Reynolds and Braxton Ashcraft led the charge for the Pirates, while Ryan O'Hearn and James Wood had notable performances for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 11-4**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dominated the New York Yankees in a lopsided 11-4 victory, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Trevor Larnach, Kody Clemens, Josh Bell, Luke Keaschall, Alex Jackson, Jasson Domínguez, and Max Schuemann all had notable performances in the game.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Sugano Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms, effective retroactive to July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have made a trade, sending RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash.
